item.title: Montana AG's office rejects proposed ballot measure on initiative process, sponsors challenge
item.description: Yet another proposed ballot measure in Montana is now caught up in legal action. Attorney General Austin Knudsen’s office ruled a constitutional amendment didn’t meet requirements for the ballot.

item.title: Montana PSC changes course on NorthWestern Colstrip intervention
item.description: As NorthWestern Energy prepared to take over majority control of the Colstrip power plant, regulators sought to intervene in the company’s plan to assign newly acquired electricity to a subsidiary.

item.title: Montana PSC approves settlement agreement over North Star water issues
item.description: The Montana Public Service Commission has reached an agreement with a Helena Valley subdivision, intended to resolve years of complaints residents have raised about water service.
